challenge.title: The Daily Circuit
challenge.detail: A rotating seeded arena. Everyone starts with the same loaner weapon and squad. Your upgrades and purchases give no advantage.
challenge.invalid: Use SQS1- followed by eight hexadecimal characters.
challenge.local: Offline challenge codes, not live multiplayer. Replay any saved code, even after its day ends. Comparisons require the same game version.
challenge.card: Same loadout. Your turn to beat this run.
journal.title: The Hall of Scrap
journal.detail: Your best runs, earned medals and wildest inventions. Progress is saved on this device. Keep playing at your own pace.
journal.empty: Your first run starts the story. Finish a battle to save its highlights here.
mastery.title: Commander mastery
synergy.title: Secret build synergies
synergy.thermalShock.detail: Choose Fire Core and Cryo Core in one run for +35% weapon damage.
synergy.stormLattice.detail: Choose Tesla Coil and Drone Core or Splitter Module in one run for two extra chain targets.
synergy.perfectStorm.detail: Choose Critical Processor and Overclock Module in one run for +15% critical chance and +20% attack speed.
